cetya.p: [Cita+ṇya] (ti) CL=10 See - Nīti, Sutta. 69] That which is the place of respect - veneration - honour, That which is the place of connecting delightfulness-joy (garden etc.).

B:
cetya：cetya（ti）
စေတျ（တိ）
[cita+ṇya．niti，sutta．69-.]
[စိတ+ဏျ။ နိတိ၊ သုတ္တ။ ၆၉-ကြည့်။]
K:
cetya：စေတျ（တိ）
[စိတ+ဏျ။ နိတိ၊ သုတ္တ။ ၆၉-ကြည့်။]
ရိုသေ-လေးစား-မြတ်နိုး-ပူဇော်-ရာ ဖြစ်သော၊ နှစ်သက်ဝမ်းမြောက်ခြင်းကို ဆက်စပ်ရာဖြစ်သော （ဥယျာဉ်စသည်）။
DOP: cetiya cetya m.n. [ S. caitya; BHS also cetiya], 1. a place or object of veneration, a sanctuary or shrine (near a village), perhaps a sacred tree and mound ; Abh 207 (cetiyāyatanāni tu); 955 (devālaye ca thūpasmiṃ ~aṃ cetiyaddume); Vin I 288, 4 (tatra sudaṃ bhagavā Vesāliyaṃ viharati Gotamake ~e); D II 75, 26 (Vesāliyaṃ viharāmi Sārandade ~e; Sv 521, 30 foll. : Sārandade ~e ti evaṃnāmake vihāre, anuppanne kira buddhe tattha Sārandadassa yakkhassa nivāsanaṭṭhānaṃ ~aṃ ahosi); 102, 6 (yena Cāpālaṃ ~aṃ ten’ upasaṅkamissāmi divāvihārāyā ti); III 11, 11 (acelo … sabbān’ eva Vesāliyāni ~āni samatikkamitvā); Sn 1013 (Pāsāṇakaṃ ~aṃ ca ramaṇīyaṃ manoramaṃ); Ja VI 68, 6 (sā mahāparidevaṃ paridevitvā rañño ṭhitaṭṭhāne ~aṃ kāretvā gandhamālādīhi pūjetvā nivatti); Spk I 351, 3 (ārāmacetyā ti ārāmacetiyāni … cittīkataṭṭhena cetyaṃ veditabbaṃ); Pj II 194, 15 foll. ; 344, 28 (anuppanne hi bhagavati … anekāni ~āni ahesuṃ yakkhanāgādīnaṃ bhavanāni); Ap-a 357, 36 foll. (tesaṃ yakkhānaṃ nivāsanaṭṭhānaṃ pūjanīyaṭṭhānattā ~an ti vuccati, evaṃ idaṃ bhagavato vasanaṭṭhānaṃ ~an ti vuccati); — 2. a place or object of veneration connected with a buddha; a funeral monument or thūpa (containing relics of a buddha or arhat or king), especially a thūpa in a vihāra; Abh 436 (thūpo tu ~aṃ bhave); 955; Vin III 143, 32 (anāpatti saṅghassa vā ~assa vā gilānassa vā karaṇīyena gacchati); Khp 8:7 (nidhī sunihito hoti itthiyā purisassa vā ~amhi ca saṅghe vā puggale atithīsu vā; Pj I 221, 30 foll. : cayitabban ti ~aṃ, pūjetabban ti vuttaṃ hoti, citattā vā ~aṃ, taṃ pan’ etaṃ tividhaṃ hoti … bodhirukkho paribhogacetiyaṃ buddhapaṭimā uddissakacetiyaṃ dhātugabbhathūpā sadhātukā dhātukacetiyaṃ); Ja I 237, 16 (~aṃ ca bodhiṃ ca pūjetvā); Ap 84, 9 (Padumuttarassa nāthassa padumaṃ nāma ~aṃ sīhāsanaṃ kārayitvā suvaṇṇenābhilepayiṃ; Ap-a 358, 2 : idaṃ bhagavato vasanaṭṭhānaṃ ~an ti vuccati, na dhātunidhānakacetiyan ti veditabbaṃ); Mil 341, 5 (sabbāpaṇaṃ kho mahārāja bhagavato navaṅgaṃ buddhavacanaṃ sārīrikāni pāribhogikāni ~āni saṅgharatanaṃ ca); 366, 18 (yoginā yogāvacarena kālena samayen’ eva cetiyaṅganaṃ sammajjitvā … sarīraṃ paṭijaggitvā nahāyitvā ~aṃ vanditvā); Bv 3:38 (Kondañño pavaro buddho Candārāmamhi nibbuto tatth’ eva ~o citto sattayojana-m-ussito); Sp 86, 20 (bhagavā dhammakarakaṃ datvā pakkāmi, taṃ anto pakkhipitvā Paṭiyārāme ~aṃ akaṃsu); 92, 28 (Thūpārāme dakkhiṇakkhakadhātu ~amhi patiṭṭhānadivase yamaka-pāṭihāriyaṃ karotū ti); 387, 12 (~assa padīpatthāya); 456, 24 (~aṃ vā patiṭṭhāpetvā bodhiṃ vā ropetvā); 623, 33 (~e gandhapūjaṃ karotha pupphapūjaṃ karothā ti); Ps I 253, 23 (~aṃ disvā pi hi buddhārammaṇaṃ … pītiṃ uppādetvā); III 244, 21 (sāyaṇhasamaye mahābhikkhu-saṅghe ~aṃ vandamāne); 412, 15 (attano anto nivesane yeva ~aṃ kāresi); V 92, 15 (sarīraṃ jhāpetvā dhātuyo ādāya ~aṃ akāsi); Spk I 284, 15 foll. (mahāpaṭhaviṃ bhinditvā rajatabubbuḷasadisaṃ ~aṃ nikkhami, satthā sahatthena ~e dhātuyo nidhesi, ajjāpi kira taṃ ~aṃ dharati yevā ti); Mp I 383, 27 (uposathadivase ~ato nīlarasmī niggacchanti); Pj I 200, 23 (mayā tassa ~e paṭākā āropitā chattaṃ ca baddhaṃ); Ud-a 97, 7 (thūpaṃ c’ assa karothā ti assa Bāhiyassa sarīradhātuyo gahetvā ~aṃ ca karotha); 408, 5 (Sāvatthiyaṃ Dhamma-senāpatino ~aṃ kārāpetvā); Mhv 25:73 (taṃ deha-patitaṭṭhāne kūṭāgārena jhāpayi ~aṃ tattha kāresi parihāraṃ adāsi ca); Thūp 216, 6 (rājā kuntaṃ parikkhipāpetvā ~aṃ taṃ parikkhipāpetvā vihāraṃ ca kāresi); Sadd 875, 16 (cete cetasi citte kataṃ ṭhapitan ti ~aṃ); Sadd 928, 1* (sārīrike paribhoge cetye uddissake pi ca sabbe ārakkhakā devā sukhaṃ yantu navaṃ navaṃ); — ifc see ākāsa- ( sv ākāsa 2 ), ārāma-, uddissaka-, kañcuka-, dhamma- ( sv dhamma 1 ), dhātu-, dhātuka-, dhātunidhāyaka- ( sv dhātu ), pada-, paribhoga-, puḷina-, rukkha-, vana- ( sv vana 1 ), sarīra-; — 3. veneration, respect ; — ifc see dhamma- ( sv dhamma 1 ); — °’- aṅgaṇa , n. [cetiya + aṅgaṇa 1 ], the open space before a thūpa; the terrace of a thūpa; Ap 457, 21 (ahaṃ pure bodhipattaṃ ujjhitaṃ ~e taṃ gahetvāna chaḍḍesiṃ); Mil 366, 16 (~aṃ sammajjitvā); Vism 392, 23 (Tissa-mahāvihāre ~asmiṃ nisīditvā); Ps III 245, 4 (thero … dakkhiṇadvārena ~aṃ ārūḷho); IV 125, 13 (pitaraṃ mañcena ~aṃ haritvā mañce nisīdāpetvā); Spk II 204, 28 (yo ~aṃ ārohanto chattaṃ dhāreti upāhanaṃ dhāreti … ayaṃ satthari agāravo nāma); — °- gabbha , m. , the inner room of a thūpa; Ja I 52, 2 (bodhisattena vasitakucchi nāma ~-sadisā na sakkā hoti aññena āvasituṃ); Ps IV 127, 24 (~e yamakamahādvāraṃ vivarantā viya taṃ pabbataṃ dvedhā katvā); — °- ghara , n. , a shrine; a building or shrine containing a thūpa or an object of veneration ; Vism 213, 3 (buddhaguṇānussatiyā ajjhāvutthaṃ c’ assa sarīraṃ pi ~am iva pūjārahaṃ hoti); Sp 474, 31 (sabbaṃ pi therena dinnakaṃ ~e ekaṃ varapotthakacittattharaṇaṃ na agghati); 748, 16 (dīghapamukhaṃ ~aṃ hoti); Ap-a 441, 28 (mahājano … cetiyaṃ kāretvā pūjesi … ayaṃ upāsako tass’ upari candanasārena ~aṃ kāretvā mahāpūjaṃ akāsi); Mhv 31:60 (cetiyaṃ ~aṃ passa bhikkhu sunimmitaṃ); — °- cchatta , n. [cetiya + chatta 1 ], the decorative parasol on top of a thūpa; Sp 1069, 27 (~-vedikādīsu); — °- ṭṭhāna , n. , 1. a suitable object of veneration ; Sv 606, 10 (amhākaṃ āyuvaḍḍhano ~aṃ puññakkhettuṃ … bhagavā) = Thūp 174, 31 ; — 2. the place or site of a thūpa or shrine; a thūpa; Sp 745, 4 (sā kira kuṭī kavāṭabaddhā gandha-paribhaṇḍakatā samosāritapupphadāmā ~am iva tiṭṭhati); Sv 554, 21 (Udenacetiyan ti Udenayakkhassa ~e katavihāro vuccati); Vv-a 156, 28 (kanakathūpe kariyamāne dārikā … ~aṃ gantvā); — °- ṭṭhāniya , mfn. , being a suitable object of veneration ; Sp 473, 4 (pabbajitaparibhogo hi āgārikānaṃ ~o, Be, Ce, Se so; Ee wr agārikānaṃ °-ṭṭhāniyyo); — °- paṭijaggaka , mfn. , attending to, in charge of, the thūpa or shrine ; Sp 1143, 12 (yo nibaddhaṃ ~o hoti pabbajito vā gahaṭṭho vā, Ee so; Ce °-jaggako; Se °-paṭijaggiko; Be nibaddhacetiyajaggako); — °- maha , m. , a festival of (worship at) a thūpa; Ap-a 442, 9 (nibbutassa bhagavato ~e vattamāne); Sadd 457, 26 (vihāramaho ~o); — °- rukkha , m. , a tree that is an object of veneration, a sacred tree ; Vin III 155, 31 (aññataraṃ ~aṃ chedāpesi gāmapūjitaṃ; Sp 575, 3 : cetiyan ti sammataṃ rukkhaṃ ~aṃ); Vism 74, 5 ; — °- vandanaka , mfn. , doing homage to the thūpa; Sp 1336, 17 (~ā cattāro therā, Ce, Ee so, perhaps wr; Be cetiyavandakā; Se cetiyaṃ vandakā); — °- vedikāsadisa , mfn. , like the rail of a thūpa; Sp 1216, 13 (vedikāvātapānan ti ~aṃ); — see also ceti.
